Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 12
Exit Policy
This chapter explains what happens when an employee leaves the company.
Notice period
After probation, the notice period is 60 days for employees in grades 1 to 3 and 90 days for
higher grades. The notice period can be shortened if your manager agrees.
Handover
Before your last day, hand over your work and documents to the person named by your
manager, and return your laptop, ID card and any other company property.
Full and final settlement
The final settlement, including salary, leave encashment and any bonus due, is paid within 45
days of your last working day.
Experience letter
The People team sends the relieving letter and experience letter by email within 7 days after
the settlement is paid.
